name: Megri Soft Limited
about: Megri Soft Limited, an IT/ITES services and consulting company, provides digital solutions and web-based products in India and internationally. The company offers digital marketing services comprising organic search engine optimization, social media marketing, advertising, and data entry; and website development and hosting, web design, website maintenance, WordPress development, PSD to HTML, and android and iphone app development services. It also provides professional content writing services, such as review, blog, social media, press release, website copy, infographic content, resume, technical, and creative article writing; and outsourcing services. In addition, the company offers e-commerce platforms, SaaS solutions, and AI-enabled application. The company exports also its products and services. Megri Soft Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.
